# bluestonepim_attribute_group_context (Resource)

Sets the name of an attribute group for a specific context, for example another language or a sales channel.

The API has no way to remove the name of a context, so removing this resource leaves the name in Bluestone as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_context" "dutch" {
  name   = "Dutch"
  locale = "nl-NL"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group" "general" {
  name = "General"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group_context" "general_nl" {
  group_id   = bluestonepim_attribute_group.general.id
  context_id = bluestonepim_context.dutch.id
  name       = "Algemeen"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `context_id` (String) The ID of the context (see `bluestonepim_context`).
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the attribute group.
- `name` (String) The name of the attribute group in this context.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_attribute_group_context.general_nl <group_id>/<context_id>
```
